_note: Catalog of product images. One entry per image file in src/assets/screens/. Every image is a crop of a real capture of the app (`cargo xtask screenshots`), never a mockup; origin stays 'capture'. source is the capture file name (without .png) and crop is [x, y, width, height] in pixels of the 1920 by 1240 window. mobile is an optional second crop (about 4:3) used on narrow screens. `use` points a slot at another entry's image. alt is required for every image: scripts/make-screens.mjs and ShotFrame fail without it. Rebuild the files with `node scripts/make-screens.mjs --captures DIR`.

hero-layout.alt: The PCBCraft Layout tab: the Layers tree on the left, a 60 by 40 millimetre board with three footprints and dashed connection lines in the middle, an empty Properties panel on the right, and the Findings sheet below.

home-schematic.alt: A schematic sheet with a connector J1, a 330 ohm resistor R1 and a green LED D1 joined by wires, with VCC and GND power symbols, row and column markers and a title block.

home-layout.alt: The board canvas: a 60 by 40 millimetre outline with chamfered corners, two mounting holes and three footprints joined by dashed connection lines, with rulers and a 60 millimetre dimension.

layout-routed.alt: A routed sensor board in the layout view: orange top copper and blue bottom copper traces joining a microcontroller, a USB connector, resistors, capacitors and LEDs inside a rounded board outline, with a 72 millimetre dimension below.

home-libraries.alt: The Library tab beside the board: a keyword box, three view buttons, a row of source filter icons, and cards for Resistor, LED, Capacitor, 2-pin connector and Protection diode, each with a short description, its source and pin count.

home-outputs.alt: The Manufacture tab with the Export dialog open: a list of formats grouped as Assembly, Fabrication, Documentation, Exchange and Packages, and a Bill of materials page with file type, columns and a preview of the first rows.

view3d.alt: The board in the 3D view from an angle: a green board with parts drawn as plain dark boxes sized from their pads, a pin header, a connector and a white antenna outline in the silkscreen.

layers-tree.alt: The Layers tree: a filter box, Show all, Hide others and New layer, then Board 60 by 40 mm, Layer 1 Top with Tracks, Solder mask, Silkscreen, Paste and Pads, Layer 2 Bottom, Board edge and Parts, each with a lock and an eye toggle.

bottom-sheet.alt: The bottom sheet under the canvas: Findings, Output and Console tabs, an All findings filter, a Run checks button, and three findings about disconnected copper islands on VCC, LED and GND, each with Show, Hide and Mute buttons.
